mapper.select: SELECT order_id,merchant_id,carrier,tracking_number,posted_at IS NOT NULL AS posted,warehouse_id FROM order_package_allocations WHERE package_id=#{packageId}
SELECT l.order_line_id,i.product_id,l.quantity FROM order_package_lines l JOIN order_items i ON i.id=l.order_line_id WHERE l.package_id=#{packageId} ORDER BY l.order_line_id
mapper.update: UPDATE shop_orders SET shipment_intent_key=#{packageId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND shipment_intent_key IS NULL
UPDATE order_package_allocations SET posted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE package_id=#{packageId} AND posted_at IS NULL
UPDATE shop_orders SET shipment_intent_key=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND shipment_intent_key=#{packageId}

UPDATE shop_orders o JOIN order_package_allocations p ON p.package_id=( SELECT candidate.package_id FROM order_package_allocations candidate WHERE candidate.order_id=#{orderId} AND candidate.posted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY candidate.posted_at DESC,candidate.package_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) SET o.status='SHIPPED',o.carrier=p.carrier,o.tracking_number=p.tracking_number, o.shipped_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),o.updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE o.id=#{orderId} AND o.status='CONFIRMED' AND o.shipment_intent_key IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_items i WHERE i.order_id=#{orderId} AND i.quantity > (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity),0) FROM order_package_lines l JOIN order_package_allocations a ON a.package_id=l.package_id WHERE l.order_line_id=i.id AND a.posted_at IS NOT NULL) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity),0) FROM order_line_refund_admissions r WHERE r.order_line_id=i.id AND r.status='SETTLED') )
